project_name: MiningStore Grundy County bitcoin mining facility
aliases: Grundy County REC bitcoin mining facility
status_detail: MiningStore says it launched a 7 MW bitcoin mining facility in Iowa at the end of 2019 with Grundy County Rural Electric Cooperative; local news reported the facility west of Grundy Center was extensively damaged/destroyed by fire in January 2025.
notes: Retained as a data-mining/server-load facility lead. MiningStore case study says 7 MW; the 2025 fire article says the site had 1,700 crypto-mining computers and nine on-site engineers, and that future plans were unknown.

project_name: Union Township cryptocurrency demand-response load resource
status_detail: Hardin County Board of Adjustment agenda for June 11, 2024 described an existing conditional use permit being modified/clarified to allow demand response load resources, defined as cryptocurrency/bitcoin mining sites, in Section 17 of Union Township.
notes: Official agenda does not name the applicant/developer or MW. A later Courier search snippet says MiningStore asked Hardin County to rezone two parcels from agricultural to manufacturing, but the article was not accessible; developer left null.

aliases: Ida County Data Center Community Information Meeting
status_detail: Ida County posted a Data Center Info Meeting for August 12, 2026 in Ida Grove. KTIV reported an August 11 county discussion and public information meeting, with no disclosed site or developer in the county materials; Eventbrite/AllEvents identify the organizer as PathOne Data Centers, whose organizer profile describes 10 MW edge data centers.
notes: Early lead; exact site not disclosed. Ida County adopted an indefinite moratorium at the end of June 2026, but local reporting says company outreach followed the moratorium.
